title: Glucose Control in Type 2 Diabetes in Pregnancy
official: Postprandial Walks for Glucose Control in Type 2 Diabetes in Pregnancy
summary: The goal of this clinical trial is to evaluate the effect of physical activity on glucose control in pregnant patients with pregestational Type 2 diabetes. The main question it seeks to answer is "will physical activity following a meal improve blood sugar control in pregnant women with Type 2 diabetes?" Researchers will compare the glucose control of two groups: one that walks for 20 minutes after each meal, and one that does not.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Singleton gestation
* Known diagnosis of Type 2 diabetes OR meets new diagnosis of Type 2 diabetes in the first trimester (up to 13 weeks and 6 days)
* Age ≥18 and \<50 years
* Gestational age \<32 weeks 0 days gestation

Exclusion Criteria:

* Non-English as the primary language
* Inability to participate in 20 minutes of walking at a time
* Known or suspected fetal anomaly or aneuploidy
* Prisoners
* Management of diabetes outside of study location

sites.f: Eastern Virginia Medical School, Macon and Joan Brock Virginia Health Sciences at Old Dominion University
